dimensions.assessment: Directly involves federal intelligence and foreign policy personnel responsible for drafting reports and strategies.
dimensions.evidence: Secretary of State, in coordination with the Director of National Intelligence and the Secretary of Defense, shall submit a classified report

dimensions.assessment: Mandates administrative reporting and strategic planning rather than direct citizen-facing changes.
dimensions.evidence: submit a classified report, as appropriate, to the relevant congressional committees

dimensions.assessment: Requires a determination of resources and funding needed, but specifies no direct appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: includes a determination of the tools, resources, and funding that should be available

dimensions.assessment: Directs executive branch reporting and a 5-year bilateral strategy directed at specific congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of State shall submit to the relevant congressional committees a detailed strategy

dimensions.assessment: Involves a one-time report and a 5-year strategy focused on international bilateral relations.
dimensions.evidence: 5-Year United States Strategy for Bilateral Relations With Georgia

missing_information: Specific cost estimates for preparing the reports and executing the strategy.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires executive branch agencies to compile classified intelligence reports and a 5-year bilateral strategy regarding Georgia, affecting agency reporting workflows and diplomatic planning without changing broad domestic laws.
